unresolvedMappings: Current xArm 1305 arm masses versus differently labelled support table; xArm 5 Lite exact historical configuration not established as an extra current SKU.
Controller masses/dimensions and wrist protocol/flange details differ across generations; no invented installed-system envelope.
Historical original Swift/Metal physical specifications, launch years, current stock and later Studio compatibility remain unknown.
uArm Swift Pro v4.10.2 removes older workflows; firmware/app-version compatibility requires further configuration-specific checks.
notAdditionalCards: xArm 5 Lite support-column label not proven to be an additional independent SKU.
Gripper G2/BIO/Vacuum/Lite tools, force/torque sensors, camera stands, controller boxes, uArm slider/conveyor and complete integrator application cells retain component/integration roles.
Third-party robot software/simulators, certified documents and SDK branches are not additional robot models.
furtherResearch: Historical uArm/Swift/Metal variants and exact regional/configuration inventories; source-code references establish selected identities, not exhaustive hardware coverage.
Version-specific controller, joint-range, end-flange and communication-protocol differences; final supplied configurations and offers.
Independent installed-cell safety/accuracy and actual application performance; manufacturer examples do not establish field outcomes.
portfolioDecisions.scope: Eight selected UFACTORY offerings, not a complete historical/regional lineup or independent performance/market-leadership proof.

comparisonEvidenceCheck.scope: Exact claim/source/status delivery; runtime tests separately verify comparison rendering and load behavior.

validation.initialValidationFindings: First unit/build/audit checks passed. Historical repository links were then refined from API endpoints to the readable canonical README pages identified in the same API responses, and final unit/build/audit checks passed on those rows. Three-model PDF table and five-model merged-cell matrix were extracted and checked separately from component tables; uArm developer p13 and release-note p25 anchors retained. No application algorithm or source profile mapping changed.
validation.scope: Twenty-six source attempts, twenty-three HTTP 200 bodies including ten PDF documents / 344 text pages and four manufacturer-linked historical README responses. Two DNS failures and one unrelated nonexistent-repository 404 retained as excluded evidence. Selected text/word-coordinate/merged-cell proof, no visual PDF or drawing transcription. Thirty-two selected browser cases including eight axe runs, not a full browser-suite rerun. Manufacturer statements are not independent testing.
